HomeV7.aboutBody: Andrade Parra Corporation is a family construction and remodeling business serving Houston and nearby areas. Jose Andrade and Mario Parra are direct contacts for discussing your project.
HomeV7.teamTitle: Direct contact from the very first conversation.
HomeV7.teamBody: Jose Andrade and Mario Parra personally handle project inquiries. This layout is ready for their portraits and approved team photography when that material is available.
HomeV7.teamGalleryBody: An editorial space ready to document the people who make each project possible.
HomeV7.faqA1: We serve Houston and surrounding areas. Share the project location so we can confirm coverage.
HomeV7.faqA2: Tell us the type of work, the location, and what you want to change. We review that information before defining the next step.
HomeV7.faqA3: Yes. After completing the form, you can attach photographs or plans to the same WhatsApp message.
HomeV7.faqQ4: Do you handle residential and commercial projects?
HomeV7.faqA4: Yes. The scope of each project is confirmed after reviewing its conditions and needs.
HomeV7.faqQ5: What information helps with the first conversation?
HomeV7.faqA5: The type of space, location, a short description of what you want to change and, if available, photos or plans. You do not need to have everything defined before contacting us.
HomeV7.faqQ6: How is the project scope defined?
HomeV7.faqA6: We first review your needs and the existing conditions. That information is then used to organize the relevant work, materials and next steps for the project.
HomeV7.faqQ7: Can I ask even if I am still comparing options?
HomeV7.faqA7: Yes. You can share your idea and the current state of the space. The first conversation helps determine whether the service and scope fit what you need.
HomeV7.faqQ8: How is communication handled during the work?
HomeV7.faqA8: Communication remains direct with the team. Important agreements and any scope changes should be clear before the corresponding stage moves forward.
HomeV7.faqPrompt: Open a question to see what is worth preparing before you begin.
HomeV7.faqStillQuestion: Is your question not listed here?
HomeV7.beforeAfterTitle: Change is easier to understand when you can compare it.
HomeV7.beforeAfterBody: The comparison is ready for verified pairs of the same space and angle as soon as approved photographs are available.
